intent.title: Compose a container's layout by drawing regions, and get ordinary flex and grid structure
steps: Select a container and choose Compose layout.
Draw regions, cut them, sweep across them to merge, drag their boundaries.
Choose Done: the page keeps the structure the layout compiled to.
expected: Every gesture is one undo step and is written at once as normal elements with flex or grid declarations, never absolute positioning.
The elements the container already held keep their ids, styles and children.
Reopening the container reopens the layout it keeps.
